national_news.title: Centre Launches Nationwide 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan-Rabi 2026' from Haryana
bullets: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the nationwide campaign 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan-Rabi 2026' from Karnal, Haryana, running until November 30.
The initiative focuses on promoting sustainable agriculture, improving soil health, and encouraging balanced fertiliser use based on soil testing.
It aims to boost crop diversification through oilseed, pulse, and horticulture missions, along with effective crop residue management and natural farming demonstrations.

national_news.title: India and Poland Hold Bilateral Talks to Strengthen Strategic Partnership
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk during his official visit to New Delhi.
Both nations agreed to deepen cooperation across key strategic sectors, including defence, space, and nuclear energy.
Poland stands as India’s largest trading and investment partner in Central and Eastern Europe.

national_news.title: Asian Para Games: Sheetal Devi & Toman Kumar Win Gold in Compound Mixed Team Archery
bullets: Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar won the gold medal in the compound mixed team archery event at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, defeating Indonesia 151-148.
Suvarna Raj secured a gold medal for India in the women’s F-54 discus throw event.
Swati Chaudhary earned a silver medal in the women’s W-1 category in para-archery.

national_news.title: 14th India Chem 2026 Inaugurated; Targets $1 Trillion Chemicals Market by 2040
bullets: Union Minister for Chemicals and Fertilisers J. P. Nadda inaugurated the 14th edition of 'India Chem 2026' in Mumbai under the theme 'Advantage Bharat: An Emerging Global Chemicals Hub'.
The Union Government set a target to expand India's chemicals and petrochemicals market to $1 trillion by 2040.
Under the proposed 'Bhavya Rasayan' scheme, the Centre will provide ₹1,000 crore for each chemical park, with participating states contributing a minimum of ₹500 crore.

national_news.title: India and New Zealand Sign MoC on Electronic Origin Data Exchange
bullets: India and New Zealand signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) on Electronic Origin Data Exchange to facilitate bilateral trade under their Free Trade Agreement (FTA).
The agreement was signed by Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) Chairman Vivek Chaturvedi and Christine Stevenson, Comptroller and Chief Executive of New Zealand Customs Service.
The initiative aims to leverage digitalisation, reduce information gaps, deepen customs cooperation, and streamline trade preferences for eligible businesses.

national_news.title: Government Sets Target to Eliminate Drug Menace by December 2029
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced a national goal to completely eliminate the drug menace from India by December 31, 2029.
Speaking on Police Commemoration Day at the National Police Memorial, he stated that 36,852 police personnel have laid down their lives in the line of duty since Independence.
A nationwide motorcycle rally themed 'Fight Against Drugs' featuring 90 riders across nine States/UTs and Central Armed Police Forces was flagged off to mark the occasion.
